title: Greedy Algorithms
definition: Greedy algorithms make local optimal choices at each step, hoping to reach a global optimum.
intuition: Take the best immediate choice available without looking ahead.
how_it_works: Selects the locally best candidate. Once chosen, choices are never reconsidered or retracted.
when_to_use: When greedy choice property and optimal substructure can be proven.
when_not_to_use: When choices have global interactions (use Dynamic Programming).
common_mistakes: Making unproven assumptions about global correctness
complexity: Often O(n log n) due to sorting, or O(n)
content: Greedy algorithms make local optimal choices at each step, hoping to reach a global optimum.
